biw_news.title: Robotic Dry Fiber Cell and 2,400-Ton Composite Press Reduce Aerostructure Build Time by 90%
biw_news.summary: The Advanced Manufacturing Research Centre showcases an advanced robotic dry fiber cell paired with a 2,400-ton composite press. This setup drastically accelerates high-rate manufacturing of complex structural composite components while maintaining strict dimensional tolerances.

biw_news.title: Thick Thermoplastic Composite Parts for the Next Generation of Aircraft and Vehicles
biw_news.summary: Daher’s Highly Loaded Thermoplastic program validates patented Direct Stamping and infrared welding technologies. These advanced joining and forming processes establish a robust structural certification basis for critical load-bearing frameworks.

biw_news.title: CFRP/Graphite Heat Dissipation Device Enables Lighter Structural Integrations
biw_news.summary: A collaborative engineering project developed a carbon fiber reinforced polymer (CFRP) and graphite composite device matching the thermal conductivity of traditional aluminum elements. The design achieves a significant 47 percent weight reduction without compromising structural integrity.

biw_news.title: ET ’27: The Global Extrusion Industry’s Technical Classroom for Lightweight Structures
biw_news.summary: The International Aluminum Extrusion Technology Seminar focuses on advancing aluminum profile design and manufacturing for lightweight body-in-white structures. The event highlights innovations in multi-void extrusions and crash-management systems for modern automotive architectures.

biw_news.title: Neuman Aluminium Improves Scrap Recovery with Advanced Furnace Retrofit
biw_news.summary: Neuman Aluminium completed a major casthouse retrofit featuring a high-efficiency stirring system to optimize closed-loop scrap recycling. This metallurgical advancement ensures consistent alloy quality for automotive-grade structural sheet and extrusion products.

biw_news.title: Hydro and Siemens Mobility Pioneer Aluminum Closed-Loop Recycling for Transport Structures
biw_news.summary: The Train2Train initiative successfully recovers structural aluminum from decommissioned transit assets to cast high-strength raw materials for new structural components. This process demonstrates scalable circular metallurgy vital for reducing the carbon footprint of structural chassis frames.
